title: UI风格#150 - Art Deco Linear (艺术装饰线条)
description: 创建第150种UI风格：艺术装饰线条风格 - 简洁线条、几何图形、黑金色调。输出到 G:/claude_code_project/web/index_planET.html

acceptance_criteria.criterion: Given Art Deco Linear style When color palette Then features matte black, champagne gold, ivory white, emerald accent
Given Art Deco Linear style When typography Then uses deco linear: Cinzel, Josefin Sans, or Poiret One
acceptance_criteria.evidence: Implemented: Cinzel (headers 2.4rem 600 weight), Josefin Sans (body 0.9rem 300-600 weight) - art deco geometric sans

acceptance_criteria.criterion: Given Art Deco Linear style When layout Then linear patterns, stepped forms, symmetrical geometry, golden ratio
acceptance_criteria.evidence: Implemented: stepped chevron borders in header/footer, symmetrical diamond decorations, linear gold divider, geometric layout

acceptance_criteria.criterion: Given Art Deco Linear style When UI elements Then gilded edges, stepped frames, linear symmetry
acceptance_criteria.evidence: Implemented: gold borders with stepped corners, diamond decorations (◆◇), linear symmetry in all elements, emerald accent highlights

acceptance_criteria.criterion: Given Art Deco Linear UI When functional Then includes glamour chat, society agents, prestige stats
acceptance_criteria.evidence: Implemented: Prestige chat panel, 4 society agents (Duke Hartwell, Countess Vera, Baron Ashworth, Lady Enid) with Rank/Estate/Charm/Grace/Wit/Power/Influence/Legacy stats

acceptance_criteria.criterion: Given Art Deco Linear UI When copy Then uses art deco: 'Prestige', 'Linear', 'Stepped', 'Gilded'
acceptance_criteria.evidence: Implemented: title 'PRESTIGE. LINEAR. STEPPED.', tagline '— The Golden Age —', button 'ASCEND', greeting 'Welcome to the grand salon...', status 'ELITE'/'IDLE', nav 'Prestige'/'Ascend'/'Attain'/'Gilded'
